docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
This section depicts my individual block diagram which is of a metal detection system in which utalizes the LDC1101DRCR metal sensor from Texas Industries. The purpose of a block diagram is to be able to visualize and organize a system that will be able to connect with adjacent team members. Some features of the block diagram includes:

  • power levels - 3.3V
  • sensor - Metal Detection
  • Actuator - Red LED
  • team connections - Downstream
  • Power source - Plug-in system

docs.title: Appendix - Module's Major Components Selection Process
Power Management
docs.text:
Solution Pros Cons Option 1. TPSM84209RKHR$5/eachlink to product * Input 4.5-28V * Fixed 3.3/5V output * 2A output * Requires 2-3 external capcitors Option 2. AP63203WU-7 $1/eachLink to product * Smaller component * Low Cost * Input 4-32V output 3.3V * Requires multiple parts * Single output Option 3. LM2575D2T$2.50/each Link to product * Robust * Simple design * Requires multiple parts * Takes up greater space

Choice: Option 2: AP63203WU-7

Rationale: The AP63203WU-7 is cheaper and is just as complex as the LM2575D2T, but with a much more balenced layout making it much easier to hand solder.

docs.title: Sensor
docs.text:
Solution Pros Cons Option 1. JDC1614RGHR$5/eachlink to product * 3.3V power consumption* Immune to environmental contaminants* Contactless sensing * Requires I2C configuration * Sensor coil must be designed Option 2. LJ12A3-4-Z $10/eachLink to product * 3 wire connection * *detects conductors, liquids, and powders * Requires 5V* No datasheet * From Amazon * Not solder mount Option 3. LDC1101DRCR$4/each Link to product * Measures both inductance and proximity profiling path * Higher speeds and resolution than the JDC1614 * Sensor coil must be designed * SPI programming required * More complex to implement

Choice: Option 3: LDC1101DRCR

Rationale: Despite being more complicated than the JDC1614RGHR, both would require a custom coil design and a PCB layout to apply which would require research to use either parts. Additionally, the LDC1101DRCR has higher processing abilities and an available datasheet.
